scenes.summary: Gilberta floats alone in the air, staring blankly at the letter in her hand, surrounded by cargo. After asking, you learn that Valley IV is short handed. She is helping with deliveries while hoping to lift everyone's spirits. At her invitation, you decide to join her in making the rounds.

lines.text: Ah, Endministrator!
Heheh. It's nothing. I'm waiting for you, Endmin. And just zoning out while I'm at it.
Delivering! The Valley has plenty of packages to send, but only a few messengers are around. That's why I'm here to help.
After all, I'm a messenger!
These packages need to go to the Hub Base. I've got quite a few more to deliver. People here have been through a terrible incident, and I wanna give them some encouragement.
Heheh... Everyone's feeling a little low after the incident. I figured your presence would brighten everyone's mood.
So, I looked through my contacts, wondering whether I should ask you to come or not... I just didn't wanna be a bother...
Maybe ... just this once, you could help me out, Endmin? Pretty please?
There are just a few ⟦key|packages⟧ left and the sun is about to set. I'm thinking we make the last deliveries together.

options: So that's why you called me here.
Mmkay. How can I help you?
So, what are you doing in Valley IV?

lines.text: This package needs to reach the ⟦key|canteen⟧. The recipient should be one of the staff there! It's almost mealtime, so we need to hurry!
If you're ready, Endmin, we can set off any time!

options: Hold on. I need to get prepared.

scenes.summary: You deliver the condiments with Gilberta. The recipient is extremely touched.

lines.text: Oh, is this our order of special condiments? Thank you, Miss Messenger — just in time!
Ugh. The underground water pipes have been contaminated by the Blight. We don't even have safe food and water anymore... The crew will have to make do with field rations.
That's rough, but you're doing an incredible job.
Now, with these condiments, field rations will taste far better...! Thank you so much for helping us. And that goes double for you, Endmin. If you weren't here, the disaster might have never ended!

Package description reads "Precision Machine Parts". I think this goes to the ⟦key|Core AIC Area⟧. I've delivered plenty of things like this. We need to make sure it arrives without a single dent or scratch — otherwise, the recipients will get really upset and loud... Fingers crossed for no hiccups!
Tell me when you're ready, Endmin, and then we'll set off!

options: Hold on. I need to get prepared.

scenes.summary: You deliver the precision parts to Andre with Gilberta. His centrifuge can finally start working tomorrow.

lines.text: Whoa! Endmin! Is this a special day?! You're personally delivering a package for me!
Our partnership with the UWST is going well. Getting clean water is our primary concern right now.
Yeah. The canteen lady also said that the drinking water has been polluted.
And thank goodness my order for the special parts has arrived! If we stay on schedule, our large facilities should be able to start working tomorrow.
Oh my... Your job sounds really tough.
Never mind me. The Endmin's here, so everyone knows things will work out! Hoohoo. I gotta dash to a job. We'll catch up on the good ol' times later.
And hello there, Miss Messenger! I hope the parts are still in good working order?
Don't worry — the package is in pristine condition!
Not just drinking water. We're also really low on industrial water. Our current solution is to use centrifuges for simple purification and pollutant removal.
Final package! Description reads "Medication". I think this one is meant for the ⟦key|medical bay⟧. Sounds like a lot of vials and bottles. We must be gentle with this one!
If you're ready, Endmin, we can set off any time!

options: Hold on. I need to get prepared.

scenes.summary: You and Gilberta deliver the medical supplies to Miguel. The medical staff no longer needs to worry about a shortage of medication. Miguel says Carly refused to get her injections. Gilberta wants to find Carly first.

lines.text: Is this the medication we've been asking for? Thank goodness it's finally arrived!
We have so many injured, and our medical supplies are running low. I can't imagine what things would be like if we didn't get restocked! You two are true lifesavers!
Oh, and Gilberta, while you were away, little ⟦key|Carly⟧ refused to get her injections again.
Again? But I told her she'd get a prize if she took her medication properly! Alright, Carly — Miss Gilberta is back!
Ooops. I guess we didn't make it in time! It's okay. I'll just schedule another delivery appointment with the recipient!
Don't sweat it. Oopsies happen. Let's just head back!
It's okay, oopsies happen. Let's just head back!
It's alright. Oopsies happen. Let's just head back!
